svg.title: Events & Cadences
svg.desc: A3 landscape reference poster: twelve team, multi-team and organisation events, each with other names used by Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, LeSS and Scrum@Scale, purpose, cadence, who, output and the toolkit tool.
svg.text: Every recurring event in one place: what it's for, how often, who comes, what it produces, and the tool to use.
